data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 experienced a prior year strengthening of $22.18 million in 2019. This was primarily driven by an under-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses, including a $13.2 million restatement for two claims from the 2018 year of account due to errors in the claim calculation process.

data.data_quality_notes: The exact reserve text for prior year development is taken from a table row, not a sentence. Gross premium mix is inferred from a narrative statement that all business is reinsurance, as no detailed segmental analysis by LOB is provided. The prior year development calculated from the claims development triangle ($0.801m strengthening) differs significantly from the figure stated in the Technical Provisions note ($22.180m strengthening). The Technical Provisions note figure is used as it is a direct statement of the movement.
